description: Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) to allow for alterations to the windows of the ground floor flat and the addition of a roof window to the single storey rear infill extension approved under planning permission 00354/56(GFF)/P2.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Proposed/existing plans, elevations and sections and sash window specifications [received 16 April 2020], and two unnumbered photographs [received 27 February 2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be higher than 2.1 metres when measured from no 54 Devonshire Road's ground level (excluding the additional 150mm height of the roof window hereby approved).
